newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish yields fall in line with Europe.
newsitem.headline: Swedish yields fall in line with Europe.

text.p: Swedish yields fell in line with Europe after German CPI showed lower April inflation and the crown strengthened against a weaker German mark.
"I think the crown will have difficulty in firming more after the fall in Astra and Pharmacia. Foreign investors may leave the Swedish stock market", one dealer said.
Traders said players were on the sidelines, keeping an eye on Europe as no U.S. statistics were due this week.
"Europe seems to be driving yields in the short run but the U.S. will be the trendsetter and influence yields in the long term", one dealer said.
